monster_templates.label: Fire
monster_templates.description: Burning: its blows scorch, and flame washes off it.

monster_templates.label: Frost
monster_templates.description: Frozen: its blows numb with cold, and ice rimes its body.

monster_templates.label: Storm
monster_templates.description: Charged: its blows crackle with lightning.

monster_templates.label: Acid
monster_templates.description: Caustic: its blows dissolve flesh and metal alike.

monster_templates.label: Dire
monster_templates.description: Grown past its kind: bigger, harder, and quicker than the rest of its pack.

monster_templates.label: Elder
monster_templates.description: Old and seasoned: stronger still, and wise to every trick.

monster_templates.label: Ancient
monster_templates.description: Older than the realm around it, with a strength that has never stopped growing.

monster_templates.label: Demonic
monster_templates.description: Touched by the fiends: brimstone in its blood and hellfire at its call.

monster_templates.label: Angelic
monster_templates.description: Touched by the heavens: its wounds close and its touch burns the unholy.

monster_templates.label: Otherworldly
monster_templates.description: Touched by somewhere else: it moves wrongly, and minds bend near it.
